paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets are divided across 13 labeled data sources, with each slice annotated by an external label and percentage connected via leader lines (no separate legend is shown, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized). The slices are: NQ in bright blue at about 31.3%; FEVER in a cyan/teal tone at about 16.1%; SNLI in orange at about 15.4%; VITAMINC in light teal/aqua at about 13.0%; MULTINLI in a pink/salmon tone at about 11.3%; ANLI in orange-brown at about 4.6%; FACTCC in yellow at about 2.6%; ENTFA in green at about 1.8%; XSUMHUL in very light blue at about 1.6%; SCITAIL in muted green/teal at about 1.2%; PUBHEALTH in pale yellow at about 0.5%; MULTIFC in very light blue at about 0.5%; and SCIFACT as a very small sliver at about 0.1%. Visually, the largest slices (notably NQ, FEVER, SNLI, VITAMINC, and MULTINLI) occupy most of the circle, with several much smaller slices clustered on the right side near the NQ segment.
